Definition: from G1722 and a derivative of G5179; to enstamp, i.e. engrave:--engrave.
BiblicalUsage: The ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious in 2 Corinthians 3:7 — so glorious that Israel could not look steadily at Moses' face.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the law engraved in stone was glorious and still could not save, which is why the Spirit writes the same law on hearts instead.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; New covenant; Glory
RelatedEvents: Moses Sees God's Glory and the Second Tablets
